node.statement: Defect-parameter monotonicity: if 0 <= delta <= Delta and a linear map with its fixed amplification family is an extended delta-inclusion, then it is an extended Delta-inclusion, because every defining delta-homomorphism defect upper bound and the two-sided (1 +/- delta) norm bounds in def-extended-delta-inclusion only weaken when delta is enlarged.
